title: Tournament App Launched
description: The Tournament Points Table app was created from scratch. Includes team management, pool-stage game tracking, knockout brackets, match management, leaderboard with tiebreaker ranking, and admin password protection.

title: Points Breakdown and Explainer Added
description: You can now click on any team's points in the leaderboard to see a detailed breakdown of where their points came from (which games, wins, byes, knockout bonuses). Also added a 'How Points Work' panel explaining the scoring system.

title: Security Hardening
description: Fixed a security issue where admin credentials could leak. Removed debug logs from production. Added Firestore security rules to protect the database. Fixed multiple vulnerabilities found during a security review.

title: Better Error Messages
description: Replaced browser alert popups with smooth toast notifications. Added character limits on all text inputs to prevent abuse. Fixed clipboard copy errors being silently ignored.

title: Updated Branding
description: Added the SWW & USC logo to the header and the event logo on the dashboard. The app now properly represents the General Sports Championship branding.

title: Fixed Knockout Bracket Seeding
description: Fixed a bug where teams were placed in the wrong slots during knockout bracket generation. Cross-pool seeding (e.g., Pool A winner vs Pool D runner-up) now works correctly.

title: Game Status Badges on Leaderboard
description: Each game on the leaderboard now shows its current status (Pool Stage, Knockout, Completed) with game-specific emojis and champion logos for completed games.

title: Fixed Critical Scoring Errors
description: Fixed multiple scoring bugs: Bye (walkover) now correctly gives 4 points instead of 2. Added a participation cap to prevent point inflation. Updated tiebreaker rules to use Wins+Golds then Silvers then Bronzes (never head-to-head or alphabetical).

title: Participation Cap Setting for Individual Games
description: Admins can now set a maximum participation cap per team for individual games. This prevents teams from earning unlimited participation points by entering many athletes.

title: Lobby/Esports Games Support
description: Added full support for lobby-style games like BGMI and Real Cricket. Schools can register multiple entries (teams), compete in sessions with placements, and earn points with configurable participation caps.

title: Fixed Ranking System
description: Fixed the ranking to use 'dense ranking' where tied teams share the same rank and the next rank is the very next number (e.g., 1st, 1st, 2nd) instead of skipping numbers (1st, 1st, 3rd).

title: Lobby Game Champions and Podium
description: Completed lobby games now show champion display with podium (1st/2nd/3rd place). Lobby session counts are included in the Games Played column on the leaderboard.

title: Comprehensive Security Audit
description: Performed a full code security audit. Hardened scoring calculations against edge cases, added null safety checks across the app, and improved accessibility for screen readers.

title: Mobile and iframe Fixes
description: Fixed multiple issues on mobile devices and when the app is embedded in the USC website: modals now display correctly, the layout works properly on iPhones (Safari/Chrome), bottom navigation stays visible, and popovers don't overflow off-screen.

title: Complete UI Redesign
description: Redesigned the entire app with a premium glassmorphism design. All components, pages, modals, and navigation got a visual refresh with smoother animations, better contrast, and a more polished look in both light and dark modes.

title: Per-Category Points Configuration
description: Individual games like Powerlifting now support custom point values for each weight category. For example, a flagship category can award more points than others.

title: Second Round Feature Added
description: Added a new 'Second Round' stage for games like Football. After pool stage, top teams from each pool play a round-robin second round before advancing to knockout semifinals.

title: Manual Knockout Matchup Builder
description: Admins can now choose between automatic seeding or manually picking which teams advance to knockout and arranging matchups using a visual VS dropdown builder. Works for both pool-to-knockout and second-round-to-knockout flows.

title: Fixed Knockout Matchups Getting Scrambled
description: Fixed a bug where manually arranged knockout matchups were being rearranged by the automatic cross-pool seeding logic. Manual matchups now stay exactly as the admin set them.

title: Fixed Browser Autofill Issues
description: Fixed an annoying issue where Chrome's autofill was populating the search bar with the tournament name and showing autofill suggestions behind the login modal. The login form no longer interferes with the search input.

title: Improved Database Performance
description: Switched Firestore to memory-only caching to prevent stale data issues. The app now always loads fresh data from the server, which is more reliable for a tournament that multiple people are viewing at the same time.

title: Fixed Login on New Devices
description: Fixed a bug where logging in from a new device or after clearing browser data showed 'Set Admin Password' instead of the normal login form. The app now correctly detects that a password already exists and shows the login form. Also fixed the related issue where admin access was permanently lost after clearing browser data.

title: Admin Changelog Page Added
description: Added a changelog page visible only to admins. Shows a timeline of all changes, fixes, and new features added to the app, written in plain language so anyone can understand what changed.

title: Fixed Points Breakdown Crash
description: Fixed a bug where clicking any points number on the leaderboard table crashed the app with 'Something went wrong'. The issue was a scoping error in the individual game breakdown calculation. Also added safety guards to prevent similar crashes and enabled error logging for easier future debugging.

title: Individual Sports Now Show Champion
description: Individual sports like Powerlifting can now be marked as completed, just like team and lobby games. When completed, the top-scoring team is shown as champion on the leaderboard with a trophy badge and a podium display on the game page. Admins can use the 'Finish Game' button to finalize standings and 'Reopen Game' to make changes.
